svg.title: Open Source Metro, modern dark visualisation
svg.desc: Synthetic demo metro map. Repositories are stations; five colour-coded lines represent commits, pull requests opened, pull requests merged, issues opened, and releases. Animated trains replay recorded events in UTC timestamp order. Lines show shared event types, not repository dependencies.
svg.text: AN ACTIVITY TRANSIT DIAGRAM / EVENT-TYPE SERVICES
